messages.author: Castro Martinez, Camila
messages.body:
Dear users,
I'm interested in trying to use colvars in Amber, to optimize the calculation time. I need to compute the distance between the center of mass of a protein to another residue. How can I do that with collective variables in Amber? Any help can be appreciated.
Best,
Camila
